items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: I wrote for two of their albums... That particular group... they were lucky enough to get Heidi Grant Murphy, a wonderful opera singer, to be part of that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Right. Yeah I recognize it. It’s a group called REL. It’s flute, violin and harp, and the singer is Heidi Grant Murphy. Am I right?
